completion_promises.criterion_text: roles/tutor/prompts/coach.md exists with <300 words and instructs the LLM to score against the six rubric criteria with 0.0-1.0 numeric values + 1-sentence evidence each, forbids free-text rubric_feedback (must be structured per RubricFeedback schema), and returns JSON matching the CoachVerdict schema (or per-criterion subset; deterministic code completes the verdict)
completion_promises.evidence: roles/tutor/prompts/coach.md created. Word count is approx. 280 (well under 300, including the JSON example block). The prompt enumerates the six canonical criterion_ids (curriculum_accuracy, ao_alignment, scaffolding_depth, grade_appropriate_language, constructive_feedback, quote_fidelity) on a 0.0-1.0 scale with a one-sentence evidence rule per criterion. The 'Rules' section explicitly states rubric_feedback items are STRUCTURED ONLY ({criterion_id, suggested_focus, target_score}) and explicitly forbids notes/raw/coach_text keys (mirrors RubricFeedback's extra='forbid' invariant). Output format is JSON-only with the CoachVerdict-shaped illustrative schema.

completion_promises.criterion_text: ASSUM-LCA-005 parse_coach_output test suite includes a discard-extra-criteria case asserting that unknown criterion IDs are silently dropped (locks down the policy)
completion_promises.evidence: Discard policy is implemented in LLMCoachAdapter._drop_unknown_criteria, which filters criterion_scores items whose criterion_id is not in CRITERION_IDS (sourced from study_tutor.tutoring.coach.rubric) before parse_coach_output runs. test_evaluate_drops_unknown_criterion_ids_silently in tests/unit/tutoring/adapters/test_llm_coach_adapter.py supplies a payload containing two extra criterion_ids ('fabricated_extra', 'another_unknown') and asserts they are absent from verdict.criterion_scores while the six known criteria remain. The filter logs dropped IDs at INFO level (greppable observability) and never mutates caller-owned data.
